description: O11 (Traditional Web): module image and its localized version created by the verbs. The image content (Byte[] binary of CreateImage and CreateLocalizedImage) goes in the args as base64 text: a 1x1 PNG. The locale comes from the only factory that the Model API has for it, IESpace.GetOrCreateLocale(Culture): `create ILocale` with args.culture. The localized image only exists in the Traditional runtime: in Reactive, Mobile and in ODC the platform refuses ('Localized Image objects can't be children of Image objects'; proof in tests/jobs-odc-negative/localized-image-reactive.json). The get reads back Width/Height 1 and OriginalFormat Png, that is, the platform read the binary.

ops._why: the copy takes the localized image (LocalizedImages 1)
